settings.heading: Your local liquidation store near Milwaukee.
settings.text:
The Great Unknown Liquidation is a family-owned store in Oak Creek, Wisconsin, run by Tyler and Kylee Rude. We buy overstock, lost and unclaimed packages, and liquidation products, and pass the savings on to DIYers, contractors and everyday shoppers.

What you'll find on our shelves:

  • Watches
  • Jewelry
  • Home goods
  • Tools
  • Renovation gear

Every visit is a treasure hunt.

settings.heading: Where will the hunt take you?
settings.text: Every aisle is new ground. Pick a stop and see what's on the shelves.
